_doc: EN — Trigger corpus for the eight skills. Each entry lists realistic queries that SHOULD select the skill and near-miss queries that should NOT. Run with tests/skills/run_trigger_eval.sh (needs Claude Code; costs tokens, so it is not in CI). Threshold: a skill passes when it triggers on >= 75% of should[] and on 0% of should_not[]. FR — Corpus de déclenchement des huit skills : requêtes réalistes qui doivent, et ne doivent pas, les activer.
_method: Negatives are deliberate near-misses, not unrelated questions: an unrelated query tests nothing. Queries are casual and bilingual on purpose — this kit answers in the user's language.
